consultant.mode: isolated same-host bounded subagent after required external mapping gate failed

checks.premise: The valid word features, scores and utilities of original/block tokens are fixed after contextual encoding; repeated block has nonempty valid support.
checks.definitions: A=sum_original w*u; C=sum_original w; B=sum_block w*u; D=sum_block w; w=q+eps>0.
checks.invariant_condition: For fixed relation score, invariance across N iff B*C=A*D. Output argmax may remain stable even if individual logits change.
checks.limits: Input-dependent denominator constants may change for every token after actual text insertion; no input-invariance or observed-task failure claimed. Positive softmax pooling has the same block identity when its unnormalized scores are fixed.

checks.premise: A task-justified inverse-relation map pi on a closed label subset, token bijection sigma, unchanged corresponding valid masks; no assumption that Re-TACRED supplies such a global permutation.
checks.sufficient_conditions: psi_sigma(t)(R*x)=U psi_t(x); phi_pi(r)=U phi_r; u_pi(r),sigma(t)(R*x)=u_r,t(x); b_pi(r)=b_r for common unitary U.
checks.result: Unitary overlap invariance gives q, raw weights, denominators and alpha correspondence; paired utilities/biases then give z_pi(r)(R*x)=z_r(x).
checks.limits: Actual affine preparation, learned independent effects, value decoder and biases are untied. Four ordered-entity role features do not impose these equations. Symmetry of overlap alone does not guarantee full-head equivariance; sufficient construction changes or restricts the method.

disposition: Do not implement/promote either broad direction on these identities. A substantive sharper target or new natural evidence is required.
next: Problem-first primary-source discovery of independently specified relational evidence structures, with full encoder/value pathway and nearest-work checks. No candidate selected, old-case fitting or experimental restart.
